description: Formatting toolbar for the Markdown editor. Renders grouped buttons for headings (H1-H3), inline formatting (bold, italic, and more), lists, links, and code that raise an OnFormat callback with the requested command. Reflects the currently active formats and honours a disabled state.

parameters.name: OnFormat
parameters.description: List of currently active format names returned by tmMarkdownEditor.getActiveFormats() (e.g. "bold", "h2", "ul").
